{"path":"test_scope.py","content":"import pytest
from scope import path_matches


def test_exact_path_glob_matches():
    """(a) An exact-path glob matches."""
    assert path_matches("src/main.py", ["src/main.py"]) is True
    assert path_matches("README.md", ["README.md"]) is True


def test_double_star_glob_matches_deeply_nested():
    """(b) A ** glob matches a deeply nested path under it."""
    assert path_matches("src/deeply/nested/file.py", ["src/**"]) is True
    assert path_matches("a/b/c/d/e/f.txt", ["a/**"]) is True
    assert path_matches("src/utils/helpers/deep/module.py", ["src/**"]) is True


def test_single_star_glob_does_not_match_extra_directory():
    """(c) A single-* glob does NOT match a path with an extra directory level in the starred segment."""
    assert path_matches("src/subdir/file.py", ["src/*/file.py"]) is False
    assert path_matches("a/b/c/d.txt", ["a/*/d.txt"]) is False


def test_path_outside_every_glob_does_not_match():
    """(d) A path outside every glob does not match."""
    assert path_matches("other/file.py", ["src/**", "docs/**"]) is False
    assert path_matches("random/deep/path.txt", ["a/**", "b/**"]) is False


def test_empty_glob_list_never_matches():
    """(e) An empty glob list never matches."""
    assert path_matches("any/path.py", []) is False
    assert path_matches("src/main.py", []) is False
    assert path_matches("", []) is False
"}
